# HEO Sovereign Protocol

> The HEO Sovereign Daemon is an autonomous multi-platform broadcast system by Joshua Hamilton. 
> This site documents the substrate, publishes dev logs, and serves as the public nexus for the Janus Gate architecture.

## Technical Stack

- Python watchdog for filesystem monitoring
- Azure Blob Storage for video hosting
- Multi-platform API integration: Facebook, Discord, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Telegram
- Autonomous Git commit + broadcast pipeline
